intro: Bolivia is officially a 'Plurinational State' with two capitals.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Sucre is the constitutional capital and La Paz the seat of government. The president is elected for five years. A 2009 constitution recognised Indigenous rights.

chapters.title: The sea question
text: Bolivia still has a navy, which trains on Lake Titicaca, and hopes for sea access.
